name: io.github.steadfeed-dev/steadfeed-site-audit-mcp
title: Site Audit MCP Server
description: Website audit tools for AI agents: schema/AI-readiness, WCAG accessibility, tech stack, PageSpeed, AI-crawler access, page changes, pay-transparency posting monitor. Runs on your own Apify account.

environmentVariables.name: APIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Apify API token (https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations). Tools run public Apify Actors on your account.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_PSI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional free Google PageSpeed Insights API key, only for the audit_pagespeed tool.
